subject.title: Autoreview rejects safe provider credential references and test placeholders

question: Should autoreview trust the exact provider/session member expressions and three explicit test fixture values proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/agent-skills/pull/103 without permitting broader dotted-reference or `test-*` patterns?
rationale: This changes a fail-closed credential-exposure boundary; source inspection establishes the false positive, but the permanent exemption set requires security-owner approval.

options.title: Approve exact allowlist
options.body: Accept only the enumerated expressions and exact fixture values, backed by unsafe near-neighbor regression cases.

options.title: Narrow further
options.body: Require more context-specific syntax or fixture-path evidence before exempting any additional expression or placeholder.

options.title: Keep current boundary
options.body: Retain the false positives for these bundles to preserve the existing fail-closed policy.

recommendation.title: Approve exact allowlist
recommendation.body: Accept only the enumerated expressions and exact fixture values, backed by unsafe near-neighbor regression cases.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history shows ownership of the same credential-scanner allowlists and security restrictions.
